posts.title: The AtomicLog + LogDrive: Strong vs weak sealing
posts.description: This post continues to elaborate on Virtual Consensus and the new Loglet abstractions of the AtomicLog and LogDrive. My last post focused on composability, this post looks at log sealing. A common aspect of segmented logs is that when extending the log with a new segment, the current active segment needs to be sealed to prevent further appends. This post discusses segment sealing in the AtomicLog

posts.title: The LogDrive: Flexible Composition Through Abstraction in Shared Logs
posts.description: In July, several Confluent colleagues and I published The LogDrive: Composable Durability for Cloud-Based Shared Logs. The paper evolves the concepts of Virtual Consensus in Delos by decomposing the Loglet abstraction into two additional abstractions that aid Loglet composition.
